variants.title: Белый мрамор и орех
variants.description: Белый мрамор с серыми прожилками, ореховые панели и графитовые детали.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one photorealistic residential lobby design using the FIRST input image as the exact architectural layout and camera. Reference images after the first inspire material/detail style ONLY.
LOCK architecture: original room width, height and floor level; same two wall planes and corner; the left staircase door opening and right double glazed door opening stay at exactly the original location and size. No extra door, window, recess or corridor. Same landscape framing and perspective. No stretching room. Any cladding above doors is FIXED wall panelling with a seam at original head, not a taller opening.
Redesign finishes, actual door leaves, handles, lights and signs cohesively. This is a MARBLE series: stone must read as natural marble grain rather than plain plaster or terrazzo. For affordable business-class construction visually propose marble-look porcelain with plausible modular joints, restrained amounts of trim, flat-panel construction. Beautiful material detail, believable reflections, balanced bright photographic exposure, neutral warm light, matte/satin floors rather than mirror shine.
Standard-door version: left stair door with a modest conventional frame and visible shallow jamb, not a concealed flush door yet. Keep its exact opening. Right passage remains two-leaf glass door, coordinated metal frame. Include exactly "ЛЕСТНИЦА" at the left door and "ЛИФТ →" on central wall; correct legible small Russian typography. No random texts. No reception desk or furniture blocking circulation; optional shallow decor only if explicitly specified below. No people, collage, watermark, or new architecture. One landscape image 3:2.

DESIGN: White Carrara-like marble with refined COOL GREY irregular veins across most of central wall and modest right-door surround, medium warm walnut wall panelling around left staircase door. Left door walnut with small graphite lever and narrow walnut frame. Marble laid in realistic rectangular panels with quiet seams, not one enormous seamless sheet. Satin cream porcelain floor mostly plain so walls take focus. Graphite right glass door, matte ivory ceiling with small dark spotlights. One slim black wall sconce on central marble. Clear restrained sophisticated high contrast of white marble and walnut. No gold, no floating shelf.
variants.flushMaterial: Match the walnut wall panelling above and beside the stair door: continuous walnut grain, remove frame and recess.
